name: BERTH 40
premise: Forty waterfront homes, each with its own yacht berth below, in Dubai Harbour; a berth and residence picker and an enquiry.
look: glossy nautical architecture photography: white hulls, teak and chrome, sparkling navy water, crisp morning sun and glowing marina nights, 24-50mm, photorealistic
palette: hull white, navy, teak, polished chrome and sea-glass green
direction: Live where your yacht sleeps. The building is shaped like stacked decks, and the water is part of every picture: hulls below balconies, teak underfoot, chrome catching sunlight. Mornings are crisp and sparkling; nights are mirrored lights on the marina. The site moves from the water up into the home and back down to the berth.
type: nautical condensed sans with numbered berths as a graphic system; navy and white with brass rules.
anchor: a slender twelve-storey residential building with long curved white balconies like stacked yacht decks, teak soffits and frameless glass, rising directly from a private marina basin in Dubai Harbour where forty berths of white motor yachts sit right below the homes, a teak boardwalk running along the water
consistency: Generate 01 first; keep the building description word for word.
Yachts are always white motor yachts of original design with navy accents and no names or logos.

shots.title: From the water
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph from the water of {anchor} on a crisp bright morning: the white curved balconies stacked above a row of gleaming white motor yachts, the navy water sparkling with sun, reflections of the hulls rippling, the Dubai skyline faint in the haze behind, fresh, glossy and exclusive.

shots.title: Your yacht below
shots.prompt: Vertical photograph looking straight down from a curved white balcony of {anchor} to the teak deck of a white motor yacht moored in the berth directly below, clear water around the hull, a coiled white rope on the deck, morning sun and crisp shadows, a dizzying and delightful view.

shots.title: Stepping aboard
shots.prompt: Photograph on the teak boardwalk of {anchor}: an owner in white linen stepping from the boardwalk onto the stern of a white motor yacht, face turned away, a crew member holding a line, chrome rails glinting, the building rising above, bright morning light. Every person is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all differ) so no face repeats; faces turned away or out of frame.

shots.title: The living room
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a residence living room in {anchor}: pale teak floors, white curved walls, navy linen sofas, polished chrome details, a wide curved glass wall onto the balcony with yachts and marina below, sea light rippling on the ceiling, nobody present.

shots.title: Rooms
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs divided by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Bottom-left: a bathroom with a white stone tub and a porthole-like round window. Bottom-right: a curved balcony with two teak loungers above the yachts.

shots.title: Marina nights
shots.prompt: Panoramic night photograph of {anchor} from across the marina basin: warm light glowing from every balcony, the yachts' deck lights on, long rippling reflections in the still navy water, a blue night sky with the skyline lit beyond, glamorous and calm.
